answer: Fingerprint escrow pays only for consistent work history. Each applicant escrows 60 credits and files a timing and task-mix fingerprint; 20 unlock per epoch while new work matches, and drift freezes the rest. The fingerprint binds to a ferrous key, so a copy changes the rhythm. Past work forms a grove of traces no copy may duplicate. Genuine sessions arrive in sparrow bursts a farm cannot script. The k-th fake needs a k-th stream and a k-th 60-credit escrow, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 60 once; rented fingerprints fail on fresh tasks.
